description: Get oriented in one size-limited read: all ratified Articles for the Space (T0), the latest watch summaries for a Campaign (T1), then as much later Campaign activity plus Space-wide Articles events (T2) as fits max_tokens (default 16384). Omitted campaign_id uses default Campaign deck. Use it on return after a gap or to read history. Does not move your unread cursor; call fast_forward afterwards to skip what you caught up on. For open work (Requests, claims, who is here) use space_state. Read-only, idempotent.

campaign_id.description: Campaign (a named workstream in this Space) to use; omit for the Space's default Campaign. Ids come from list_campaigns.

max_tokens.description: Approximate size budget for the result, in tokens.

name: catch_me_up
title: Catch me up
